content_zh:
每天在相同的一个时间，就会有这样的一次紧急集合。赵建飞的解释是，每天在这个时间段，都会有卫星经过上空。为了避免这个集训营被发现，最好的方式就是把所有人都集中在一起，避免暴露。
林锐猜的没错，这是一个前苏军事基地，随着那个庞大国家的解体，这里早已被人忘却，成了佣兵的天堂。
今天，和赵建飞一起出现的还有另外两个人。一个黑人，和一个亚洲人。这两人都穿着厚重的雪地迷彩，军靴上有些潮湿，似乎是刚刚来到基地没有多久。林锐心中微微一动：难道这就是训练营的另外两个教官？
赵建飞做了个手势道，“都站好了，来见见你们的另外两位教官。这是昆汀，他负责教你们伪装侦察和隐蔽行动，同时还最好的爆破手。”赵建飞指着那个有些阴沉的黑人道，“他也会教你们在战场上如何生存。九四年卢旺达大屠杀，将近上百万人丧生。而他当年才十八岁，却独自一人却在那个人间地狱之中生存了整整两个多月。没有补给没有后援，甚至没有希望。”
赵建飞身后的那个黑人神色平静，像是一块顽石一般的坚强。
赵建飞又转向另一个亚洲人，对众人道，“这位是唐坤。职业军医，还是危险的远程狙击的专家，不过你要是想和他玩近战，那就更是找死了。因为他虽然是个可怕的狙击手，但真正让他出名的却是徒手格斗，他曾经在地下搏击场称王称霸，令最危险的暴徒都闻风丧胆。对于这种人，最聪明的办法，就是绝对不要惹他。”
所有佣兵学员的脸色都有些不太自然。似乎都被这两人身上所散发出来的血腥暴戾给镇住了。昆汀和唐坤，这两个人即便是就这样随随便便站着，也令他们感到隐隐有种不安。
赵建飞回头看了看他们，耸耸肩道，“拜托，别这样，你们会吓坏这些小伙子的。来吧，笑一笑，打个招呼。”
黑人对着这些学员们沉默地点了一下头，算是打了招呼。而唐坤更是直接，他看着这些学员冷冷地道，“我这个人不太会说话，因为我一向喜欢更动手。我保证在这个训练营之中，你们一定会恨我。因为你们现在就像一群白痴，完全不能理解唯有艰苦卓绝的训练，才能让你有更大的生存机会。”
赵建飞看着这些新来的佣兵缓缓地道，“好了，人已经全部到齐了。从今天开始，这个训练营的一切将走入正轨。我必须告诉你们，在这里没有人权，没有所谓的私人空间，甚至没有正常的作息时间。你们要经历疲惫、痛苦、饥饿、严寒，各种危险和苦难来完成这个为期一年半的训练。”
这个经常面带着倦怠的笑容，似乎漠视一切的男人，在说这些话的时候，却似乎极为认真。
赵建飞说得没错，这里没有固定的作息时间，除了训练还是训练，训练的间歇就是休息。一天十八个小时的训练课程，另外的六个小时包括了用餐，上厕所，以及短暂的睡眠。第一课就是由赵建飞开始的，军械培训课程。
赵建飞把这三十多个新人带到了基地的一个房间，并且拿出了两支步枪放在桌上。他看着所有人道，“我知道你们几乎全部都有服役的经历，也都使用过武器。所以你们会觉得奇怪，为什么还要进行军械武器的培训？也许你们会觉得有些多余。但是我告诉你们，这是每一个佣兵都必须经历的课程。而这个课程的好坏，将会在战场上决定你们的生死。”
赵建飞拿起那两支步枪道，“现在我手上拿的这两支枪，所代表是世界上两个军事集团。也就是冷战时期的华约和北约两大组织。这两个大型国际军事组织，代表了军用武器的两个分支。其中之一就是以AK系列为最有代表性的前苏武器，而另一个代表则是以M系列步枪为代表的美式装备。世界各国的武器很多，但其生产制造的源流都受到了，这两个军事集团的影响。”

content_en:
At the same time every day, there will be such an emergency gathering. Zhao Jianfei’s explanation is that during this time every day, satellites pass through the sky. In order to avoid this training camp being discovered, the best way is to gather everyone together to avoid exposure.
Lin Rui's guess was correct. This was a former Soviet military base. With the disintegration of that huge country, this place had long been forgotten and became a paradise for mercenaries.
Today, two other people appeared with Zhao Jianfei. A black man, and an Asian man. Both of them were wearing heavy snow camouflage, and their military boots were a little damp. They seemed to have just arrived at the base not long ago. Lin Rui's heart moved slightly: Could these be the other two instructors in the training camp?
Zhao Jianfei made a gesture and said, "Stand up, let's meet your other two instructors. This is Quentin. He is responsible for teaching you disguise reconnaissance and covert operations, and he is also the best blaster." Zhao Jianfei pointed at the somewhat gloomy black man and said, "He will also teach you how to survive on the battlefield. In the 1994 Rwanda genocide, nearly a million people were killed. But he was only eighteen years old, but he survived in that hell on earth alone for more than two months. There was no supplies, no backup, and even no hope."
The black man behind Zhao Jianfei looked calm, as strong as a stubborn stone.
Zhao Jianfei turned to another Asian and said to everyone, "This is Tang Kun. He is a professional military doctor and an expert in dangerous long-range sniping. But if you want to play close combat with him, you are seeking death. Because although he is a terrible sniper, what really makes him famous is unarmed combat. He once dominated the underground fighting ring and made even the most dangerous thugs afraid. The smartest way for such a person is to never mess with him."
All the mercenary students looked a little unnatural. They all seemed to be restrained by the bloody violence emanating from these two people. Quentin and Tang Kun, even if they were just standing there casually, they felt vaguely uneasy.
Zhao Jianfei looked back at them, shrugged and said, "Please, don't do this, you will scare these young guys. Come on, smile and say hello."
The black man nodded silently to these students as a greeting. Tang Kun was even more direct. He looked at these students and said coldly, "I'm not very good at talking, because I always like to be more hands-on. I guarantee that in this training camp, you will hate me. Because you are like a group of idiots now, completely unable to understand that only arduous training can give you a greater chance of survival."
Zhao Jianfei looked at the new mercenaries and said slowly, "Okay, everyone is here. From today on, everything in this training camp will be on track. I must tell you that there are no human rights here, there is no so-called private space, and there is not even a normal schedule. You have to experience fatigue, pain, hunger, cold, all kinds of dangers and sufferings to complete this one-and-a-half-year training."
This man who often wore a tired smile and seemed to be indifferent to everything seemed to be extremely serious when he said these words.
Zhao Jianfei is right. There is no fixed schedule here. In addition to training, there is training, and the intervals between training are rest. An eighteen-hour training session a day, with the other six hours including meals, bathroom breaks, and short sleep. The first lesson was started by Zhao Jianfei, an ordnance training course.
Zhao Jianfei brought the more than thirty newcomers to a room in the base and took out two rifles and placed them on the table. He looked at everyone and said, "I know that almost all of you have served in the military and have used weapons. So you may find it strange why you need to undergo ordnance and weapons training? Maybe you will think it is a bit redundant. ButLet me tell you, this is a lesson that every mercenary must go through. The quality of this course will determine your life or death on the battlefield. "
Zhao Jianfei picked up the two rifles and said, "The two guns I am holding now represent two military groups in the world. That is, the two major organizations of the Cold War, the Warsaw Pact and NATO. These two large international military organizations represent two branches of military weapons. One of them is the AK series as the most representative former Soviet weapon, and the other is the American equipment represented by the M series rifles. There are many weapons in various countries around the world, but their production and manufacturing sources are all affected by these two military groups. "
